text:
Maria (CS): Heads-up: AstraLean onboarding — we started seeing a 95th-ptl tail spike on /v1/chat/generate since last night, affecting some demo flows. Renewal + health flagged if this keeps up :grimacing:
Lee: numbers? p50/p95 and sample request?
Maria (CS): p50 ~140ms, p95 ~1.2s for 512-token prompts. Traffic is ~15rps steady during demo windows. Error rate unchanged.
Jasper (SE): thanks. Any KV-cache misses or unusual context lengths?
Maria (CS): metrics show increased KV-cache churn — customer has variable prompt lengths, lots of 1–3 shot examples. GPU util fine, but downstream latency spikes correlate with cold-cache windows.
Sam (Infra): quick thought — conservative fix is model swap -> a compact quantized variant with smaller KV footprint + a routing policy to keep low-latency pool. Suggest compact-lite-v2-int8 as a candidate (estimated 2.2x token/sec improvement).
Jasper (SE): I can test compact-lite-v2-int8 locally. If it matches quality, we can do a canary with 10% traffic. Quality delta historically <1% on our eval set but will run prompt-specific checks.
Tia (Solutions Eng): FYI customer has renewal review next week, we should move fast but safe. Recommend: (1) run canary 10% w/ monitoring, (2) enable prefix cache for repeated system prompts, (3) apply routing rule to prefer low-latency pool for requests under 1s SLA.
Maria (CS): Agreed. Can we get a routing snippet we can push?
Sam (Infra): Pushing a minimal canary + route override. Sample YAML for route policy:
```yaml
routes:
  - name: astralean-llm-canary
    match:
      - path: "/v1/chat/generate"
        headers:
          - name: "x-customer-id"
            value: "astralean"
    policy:
      canary: 0.1
      prefer_pools: ["low-latency-rtx-pool"]
      fallback: "compact-lite-v2-int8"
      monitoring: ["p50","p95","tokens_per_sec","quality_score"]
```
Sam (Infra): We'll attach the canary metric dashboard and alert on p95 > 800ms for 5m.
Jasper (SE): I'll run evals on their prompt set now and post a short report in this thread. If quality holds, we approve.
DeployBot: deploy request accepted — job #deploy-824 enqueued (canary).
Maria (CS): Action items: Jasper -> quality eval (ETA 60m), Sam -> create canary + dashboard (ETA 30m), Lee -> coordinate customer-facing note once canary looks stable. I'll capture this as a renewal-risk mitigation.
Tia (Solutions Eng): If canary shows small regressions, we can instead try int8+kv-compress toggle (lower memory, keep model). Good to have fallback plan.
Jasper (SE): quick update — first 100 evals: exact-match for critical intents unchanged, minor paraphrase variance ~0.6%. Uploading eval.csv to the enablement folder.
Maria (CS): awesome. Sam, flip canary when ready and ping me.
Sam (Infra): Canary is live: astralean-llm-canary -> 10% traffic routed. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/teams/astralean/canary-824
Maria (CS): Monitoring — p50 steady ~130ms, p95 down to 420ms for canary. No error increase. :tada:
Tia (Solutions Eng): Great. I'll draft the renewal note to highlight decreased tail latency and projected MRR impact from better demo experience.
Maria (CS): Thanks team. Closing loop once canary reaches 24h stable or if any quality alerts fire.
